summary: On June 23, 2024 a threat actor exported the Ethereum blog's mailing list (3,759 addresses), merged it with their own list and sent 35,794 phishing emails falsely claiming the Ethereum Foundation and Lido offered a 6.8% staking yield, linking to a crypto-drainer site. Ethereum disclosed the incident on July 2, said on-chain analysis showed no investor losses, blocked further sends and moved mail services to other providers.
